DEED

This Deed is made on June 30, 2003

BETWEEN UMRE Corp., a New Jersey corporation, having a mailing address at 56
Haddon Avenue, Haddonfield, New Jersey 08033, referred to as the Grantor.

AND  Tommar, LLC, a New Jersey limited liability corporation, having a mailing
address of 89 Haddon Avenue, Haddonfield, NJ 08033 and J. Del Duca, LLC, a New Jersey
limited liability corporation, having a mailing address of 89 Haddon Avenue, Haddonfield, NJ
08033, both referred to collectively as the Grantee.

Transfer of Ownership.  The Grantor grants and conveys (transfers ownership of) the
property described below to the Grantee.  This transfer is made for the sum of  THREE
MILLION FIVE HUNDRED THOUSAND DOLLARS  ($3,500,000.00).  The Grantor
acknowledges receipt of this money.

Tax Map Reference.  (N.J.S.A. 46:15-2.1)  Municipality of Haddonfield, Block 22, Lot
No. 1.01.

Property.  The property consists of the land and all the buildings and structures on the
land in the Borough of Haddonfiel...

(5) South 28 degrees 45 minutes 00 seconds West along said lands, 33.01 feet to a pipe; thence

Being Lot 1.01 Block 22 on the Tax Map.
